shots.title: Infer active sprint pointer from branch, roadmap, retros, and git history (#507)
shots.notes: Added portable sprint inference from explicit flags, tracked pointer, branch name, recent git history, pending roadmap sprint, and latest scorecard fallback.

shots.title: Add sprint resume command that reconstructs local sprint phase and ticket progress (#507)
shots.notes: Added `slope sprint resume --portable` and top-level `slope resume` to recreate fresh local sprint-state and restore claim pointers without importing runtime DB, locks, metrics, or baselines.

shots.title: Add optional tracked active-sprint pointer without syncing runtime DB or locks (#507)
shots.notes: Added `slope sprint resume --write-pointer` for `docs/backlog/.sprint-active.json`, including source branch, source commit, evidence, claim pointers, local-only exclusions, and unsafe resume rules.

shots.title: Document cross-machine resume and decide committed common-issues mirror behavior (#507)

hazards.description: During closeout, three `slope sprint gate` writes were accidentally run in parallel. Final state remained correct after sequential verification, but this repeated the S142 process hazard.

shots.notes: Added `docs/backlog/sprint-resume.md` with the cross-machine resume flow and an explicit decision not to commit `.slope/common-issues.json` as an automatic mirror.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite continues to emit known temp-repo stderr, CRLF, and path warnings, but all tests passed.
`slope commit-ready` reported `CODEBASE.md` stale even after `slope map --check` reported CURRENT; this is being raised as a follow-up SLOPE issue.

training.description: Portable sprint recovery should restore durable intent, not machine-local runtime internals.
training.outcome: The resume pointer carries sprint, phase, evidence, and claim pointers while excluding local DBs, locks, metrics, and baselines.

training.description: Unsafe resume checks should be explicit and printable.
training.outcome: Portable resume prints branch, HEAD, evidence, and unsafe conditions before writing local state, and requires `--force` for branch, commit, evidence, or local-state conflicts.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/sprint-resume.test.ts tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts tests/cli/sprint-inference.test.ts tests/cli/sprint-state.test.ts tests/cli/registry.test.ts tests/cli/init-summary.test.ts` passed: 81 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, and `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 229 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3622 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Strong and needed. This closes a real portability gap by separating durable sprint intent from local operational state.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When `.slope/` is intentionally ignored, give agents a tracked handoff pointer with explicit safety checks instead of trying to sync the ignored runtime directory.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: `commit-ready` and `map --check` disagreed about codebase-map freshness after the S142 map fix, which is exactly the kind of SLOPE-self issue this phase should capture.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S144 can publish the recovery phase with portable resume included and the remaining SLOPE defect triaged.

bunker_locations: Do not parallelize SLOPE commands that mutate sprint-state or claim/gate state.
`commit-ready` and `slope map --check` can currently disagree about `CODEBASE.md` freshness when the map is ignored or not tracked.
Portable recovery should refuse divergent branch or missing-evidence pointers unless force is explicit.
yardage_book_updates: `src/cli/sprint-resume.ts` centralizes portable resume pointer loading, inference, safety validation, and evidence collection.
`slope sprint resume --portable` reconstructs local sprint-state and claim pointers from tracked artifacts.
`slope sprint resume --write-pointer` writes `docs/backlog/.sprint-active.json` without syncing runtime DB, locks, metrics, or baselines.
`slope resume` is a top-level portable resume alias.
`docs/backlog/sprint-resume.md` documents cross-machine resume and keeps common-issues ranking local-only by default.
course_management_notes: Validation passed: focused S143 tests, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, `corepack pnpm test`, `slope roadmap validate`, and top-level resume dry-run smoke check.
Issue #507 should close when the PR containing S143 merges.
